entries.source: Approximate physical fundamental of the Earth-ionosphere cavity resonance. Often printed as 7.83 Hz. It wanders.
entries.description: A geophysical reference. Rendering it as a stereo audio difference is not an electromagnetic treatment and not PEMF. The NASA-hosted Stolc summary prints 7.83, 14.3, 20.8, 27.3 and 33.8 Hz. A separate NASA technical report prints the same harmonics beside an approximate fundamental of 7.8 Hz (https://ntrs.nasa.gov/api/citations/20120000051/downloads/20120000051.pdf). These are cavity-resonance averages, not treatment tones. The live page https://www.greatdreams.com/hertz.htm also prints 7.83 as an Earth-resonance claim from a different source code.
